title: 第1919章 入侵失败第1918章 压制
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 闲将军盯着血源大人，没有说话。
见状，血源大人还以为筹码不够吸引人，他继续加大了筹码，想要劝说闲将军帮助自己。
秦易抬头，注视着闲将军。
“闲将军。”
之前跟闲将军见过几次，但后者不善言辞，而且一直都是作为五大家族的代表参会，并没有太多的发言。
秦易对闲将军的印象还是不错的。
“一起联手，杀了他。”秦易说道。
以他的实力，想要斩杀血源大人，问题也不大，但需要耗费不少时间。
他害怕贻误战机。
闲将军点头，而后直接加入战局之中。
轰！
当闲将军爆发出造化境八重的修为的那一刻，秦易也是一愣，没想到他才是隐藏最深的人。
接连两个与自己实力相当的人出现，这让血源大人也是一脸懵逼。
他恨不得将虎夔城的情报系统直接手撕了。
这特么都是给的什么情报啊？
没办法的情况下，血源大人也只能施展出了最后的杀手锏。
杀！
他体内的血液，迅速的与造化之门融合在一起，爆发出了最强的力量，猛地朝着两人攻击而去。
咔嚓！
闲将军抬手一击，轰碎了血源大人的攻击。
见状。
血源大人再也不敢耽搁，想要离开这座阵法。
只要逃出阵法，他就有办法离开。
轰！
然而，当血源大人以为自己早已摸清楚了阵法的命门，可以随意进出的时候，现实又给他来了当头一棒。
咔嚓！
他拼尽全力，攻击阵法中枢，却惊骇的发现，阵法中枢周围有着一层恐怖到极致的防御，他的攻击根本无法破开阵法中枢的防御。
而且，与此同时，秦易也是彻底催动了北野玄龙阵。
恐怖的阵法之力，纵横交错，刹那间便将血源大人彻底压制。
“怎么可能？”
一旁的闲将军彻底惊呆了，他瞠目结舌，内心掀起了惊涛骇浪。
这还是他们之前参悟的护城大阵吗？
为何他在阵法之中，感觉到了心悸。
content_en:
General Xian stared at Lord Bloodyuan and said nothing.
Seeing this, Master Bloodsource thought that the chips were not attractive enough, so he continued to increase the chips, trying to persuade General Xian to help him.
Qin Yi raised his head and stared at General Xian.
"General Xian."
I have met General Xian several times before, but the latter is not good at speaking. He always attends meetings as a representative of the five major families and does not speak much.
Qin Yi still had a good impression of General Xian.
"Join hands and kill him." Qin Yi said.
With his strength, it would not be a big problem to kill Lord Blood Source, but it would take a lot of time.
He was afraid of wasting his chance.
"Okay."
General Xian nodded, and then directly joined the battle.
boom!
The moment General Xian burst out with the cultivation of the eighth level of the Creation Realm, Qin Yi was also stunned. He did not expect that he was the one who hid the deepest.
"You..."
Two people of similar strength to him appeared one after another, which made Lord Bloodsource confused.
He wanted to tear Hukui City's intelligence system apart with his own hands.
What kind of information is this?
With no other choice, Master Bloodyuan could only use his final trump card.
kill!
The blood in his body quickly merged with the Gate of Creation, bursting out with the strongest power, and violently attacked the two of them.
Click!
General Xian raised his hand and struck, shattering Lord Bloodsource's attack.
See this.
Lord Bloodyuan did not dare to delay any longer and wanted to leave this formation.
As long as he escapes from the formation, he will have a way to leave.
boom!
However, just when Lord Blood Source thought that he had figured out the formation's vitality gate and could enter and exit at will, reality gave him another blow.
Click!
He tried his best to attack the center of the formation, but was horrified to find that there was an extremely terrifying layer of defense surrounding the center of the formation. His attacks could not break through the defense of the center of the formation.
Moreover, at the same time, Qin Yi also completely activated the Beiye Black Dragon Formation.
The terrifying power of the formation criss-crossed, completely suppressing Lord Bloodsource in an instant.
"How is that possible?"
General Xian on the side was completely stunned. He was dumbfounded and felt a turmoil in his heart.
Is this still the city defense formation they learned about before?
Why did he feel palpitations in the formation?
